Wrist.note: checks the left wrist display (forearm across the chest, torso bent forward, helmet down), right glove taps it twice, OK nod, back to idle; from/to idle_params(0.0), boots planted

LookAround.note: idle variation: looks round the base to the left (~56 deg: hip yaw + waist twist + head), then right (~52 deg) and ~22 deg up at the low Sun with the right glove shading the visor, back to the front; from/to idle_params(0.0), boots planted

Insert.note: right hand takes the Battery from a right-thigh pocket (grab_frame), both hands push it into a slot ~0.5 m ahead at chest height, 2.5 cm click, let go (release_frame), back to idle; play backward = pull out and pocket. Battery prop: bone child of RightHand

Idle.note: standing breath + weight shift, boots planted

Pour.note: bag lifted and tipped ~75 deg, boots planted

JumpStart.note: idle -> lunar crouch (bottom f16) -> push -> take-off on the toe tips, hips +1.2 m/s at the last frame; scrub by wind-up progress

JumpAir.note: flight pose, scrub by flight progress u (0 take-off, 0.5 apex, 1 touch-down); no vertical root motion, boots reach z=0 on the last frame

JumpLand.note: touch-down (hips arrive at -1.24 m/s) -> absorb (bottom f7) -> idle_params(0.0)

Jump.note: JumpStart + flight on the real parabola (apex f47) + JumpLand in one clip

Run.note: Apollo alternate-foot lope, 2.0 m/s, contact 0.333s + flight 0.333s per step, step 1.33 m

Walk.note: lunar walk, planted at 1.0 m/s, left heel strike at t=0, duty 0.6

Carry.note: two-hand bag carry, planted at 0.8 m/s, left heel strike at t=0
